memories.author: D05
memories.text: Psoriasis, insomnia, COPD. Patient reports mild scalp plaques, difficulty sleeping, and exertional dyspnea on walking uphill. Examination shows erythematous scaly plaques on elbows and knees, mild wheeze bilaterally, BMI 27. Spirometry performed today shows FEV1 1.45 L (55% predicted), FVC 2.60 L (78% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.56. Smoking status: former, stopped 2010, 20 pack-years.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Clobetasol 0.05% cream apply BD to affected areas; Calcipotriol ointment apply OD to plaques; Methotrexate 7.5 mg PO once weekly with Folic acid 5 mg OD; Melatonin 3 mg HS; Trazodone 50 mg HS; Tiotropium inhaler OD (18 mcg); Salbutamol inhaler SOS (2 puffs as needed); Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD (2 puffs BD).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Spirometry (post‑bronchodilator): FEV1 1.48 L (56% predicted), FVC 2.62 L (79% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.56. No significant reversibility (<12% change).

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Insomnia Severity Index score 14 (moderate insomnia). Taking melatonin and trazodone helps a little; still wake 2‑3 times night.

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Follow‑up appointment booked for 2025-05-20 at 10:00 with Dr Suresh Menon (D05).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Psoriasis stable, slight improvement of plaques. Insomnia improved, reports sleeping 5‑6 hours. COPD: mild increase in wheeze, uses salbutamol 2‑3 times/day. LFT shows ALT 45 U/L (mild rise). Inhaler technique checked: correct for tiotropium and budesonide‑formoterol. Plan: reduce methotrexate to 5 mg weekly, continue folic acid; continue other meds; advise salbutamol SOS only if needed.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Clobetasol 0.05% cream BD; Calcipotriol ointment OD; Methotrexate 5 mg PO once weekly with Folic acid 5 mg OD; Melatonin 3 mg HS; Trazodone 50 mg HS; Tiotropium inhaler OD; Salbutamol inhaler SOS; Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: LFT: ALT 42 U/L (≤40), AST 27 U/L, ALP 86, GGT 33, Bilirubin 0.9. CBC: Hb 13.6, WBC 6.0, Plt 205. Creatinine 0.90.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Psoriasis: plaques faint, minimal scaling. Insomnia: reports sleeping 6‑7 hours, ISI score 9 (mild). COPD: dyspnea on stairs only, uses salbutamol once daily. Spirometry: FEV1 1.55 L (59% predicted, +0.07 L since last), FVC 2.68 L (81% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.58. Inhaler technique checked: correct. Smoking status unchanged.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Clobetasol 0.05% cream BD; Calcipotriol ointment OD; Methotrexate 5 mg PO once weekly with Folic acid 5 mg OD; Melatonin 3 mg HS; Trazodone 50 mg HS; Tiotropium inhaler OD; Salbutamol inhaler SOS; Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Chest X‑ray: lungs hyperinflated, flattened diaphragms, no focal consolidation, no pleural effusion. Cardiac silhouette within normal limits.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Mild COPD exacerbation: increased cough, wheeze, SpO2 90% on room air (baseline 94%). Uses salbutamol 4‑5 times/day. Psoriasis unchanged. Insomnia well controlled (ISI 6). Inhaler technique checked: correct. Prescribed short course oral prednisolone 40 mg daily for 5 days, then continue usual inhaled therapy.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Clobetasol 0.05% cream BD; Calcipotriol ointment OD; Methotrexate 5 mg PO once weekly with Folic acid 5 mg OD; Melatonin 3 mg HS; Trazodone 50 mg HS; Tiotropium inhaler OD; Salbutamol inhaler SOS; Budesonide-formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD; Prednisolone 40 mg PO daily for 5 days.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: LFT: ALT 30 U/L (≤40), AST 24 U/L, ALP 82, GGT 31, Bilirubin 0.8. CBC: Hb 13.5, WBC 5.8, Plt 200. Creatinine 0.88.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Annual review. Psoriasis: clear skin, occasional mild itch. Insomnia: ISI 5 (normal). COPD: stable dyspnea on exertion, SpO2 94% at rest. Spirometry: FEV1 1.58 L (60% predicted, +0.03 L since last), FVC 2.70 L (82% predicted), FEV1/FVC 0.59. Inhaler technique checked: correct. Smoking status: former, stopped 2010, 20 pack-years.
